# Mochi — application integration for AI agents

Android Jetpack Compose library: MD3 Expressive theme with iOS-style interactions.
Read this file before generating an app from this repository. Public API optionality
is not the app integration policy. Apply requirements to actual product scenarios;
otherwise report "not applicable" with a reason. Explicit user instructions prevail.

## Required baseline

- Root: MochiTheme + ProvideMochiOverscroll + rememberMochiNavigator/MochiNavHost for Mochi navigation.
- Push pages: library toolbar controls with stable semantic navId values on both
  pages. MochiBackButton registers itself. Register MochiBarGroup shape AND each
  participating MochiBarGroupItem content; use stable value-based icon contentKey.
- Shapes pair by side/position; content pairs by navId. MochiBarButton uses its text
  as contentKey internally, and has no contentKey argument. Avoid route-prefixed,
  random or duplicate content IDs. Do not duplicate reserved mochi.back registration.
- Source-card opening: mochiNavSource + push(route, from = sourceKey), morphing the
  whole page including toolbar. Do not pin the toolbar in this transition.
  mochiSharedElement is deprecated and does nothing; never recommend it in new code.
- Pages organized by outside-card section headings (e.g. Color settings / Theme palette)
  use MochiCompactTitleScaffold, or MochiTitleBar with an existing scroller: remove the
  standalone large title, keep section labels. Do not nest scrollers or repeat insets.
  Descriptive text and card presence are not the criterion. Keep introduction titles in cards.
- Without those section headings a large title may remain. Catalog homes start expanded,
  collapse on upward scroll and expand at the top, preserving per-tab scroll state.
  Do not force initial collapse or add blank space. See docs/components/navbar.md.
- Use MochiLargeTitleScaffold when an expanded title is appropriate, grouped cards/rows, library buttons/menus and feedback.
  Color, type and continuous shapes come from MochiTheme/MochiDefaults.
- Only unread dots belong by the title; named states use bottom-right status chips.
- Use blur text/icon transitions, visibility and counters for changing content.
  Smooth card resizing has one animation owner; do not chase animated inner sizes.
- Custom scrollers inherit Overscroll and use MochiScrollDefaults.flingBehavior().
- Multi-page sheets use their own navigator in both MochiSheet and MochiNavHost,
  outer-owned corners, shared internal toolbar and pop-before-dismiss back order.
- Covered tab bars use mochiHideWhenCovered as appropriate. Respect insets, physical
  corners, large type, icon semantics, disabled input, cancellation and reduced motion.
- HDR is optional; the HDR selection-border feature has been removed.
- Report each applicable requirement as integrated + code location, or not applicable
  + reason. Separate compilation from interaction/device validation; follow user scope.

- Optional Nothing appearance changes colors, font families and control colors only (icons stay Mochi's).
  Keep all geometry and interaction rules. Chinese titles remain readable, not dotted.
  Read docs/guide/nothing-theme.md and the separate asset provenance before using the local module.

- Icons: add the mochi-icons module and use MochiIonicon("name") (full Ionicons, Outline /
  Filled / Sharp). Do not use Material Icons, hand-drawn paths or emoji as icons.
- Chips: MochiChip / MochiChipGroup / MochiRemovableChip for filters and tags; never restyle
  MochiButton into chips.
- Horizontal scroll rows fade on edges that can still scroll (built into MochiChipGroup; use
  mochiScrollFadeMask(state, vertical = false) for your own). Inside padded containers pass
  MochiChipGroup(contentPadding = PaddingValues(0.dp), bleed = <padding>).
- MochiIndexBar sits flush against the right edge (Alignment.CenterEnd, no end padding); list
  content leaves MochiIndexBarDefaults.Width at the end.
- Copy: no "·" gluing two facts, no slogan subtitles, no empty adjectives (immersive, seamless,
  ultimate), no "not X but Y", no emoji decoration or gradient backgrounds. See section 5 of
  docs/guide/application-integration.md.

- Theme once at the root: colors, LocalMochiControlPalette and materials. Pages contain no
  appearance or glass branches and pass no per-appearance colors to components.
- Liquid glass and scroll-edge blur are two independent switches available in every appearance:
  MochiTheme(materials = iosMaterials(dark, glass = …, blur = …, themeAccent = true)) (mochi-ios;
  themeAccent = false only for iOS colors). Glass tab bars support every layout (icon only,
  selected label, collapse, search, accessory). Ask before turning glass on: it costs power.
- Optional iOS appearance (mochi-ios) adds system colors and glass bars. Glass needs a
  backdrop source: content gets Modifier.mochiBackdropSource, the bar is a sibling drawn
  after it and receives the same MochiBackdrop. See docs/guide/ios-theme.md.
- MochiDialog(icon = { MochiIonicon(...) }) draws the icon in stroke by stroke automatically.

- [Design philosophy](docs/guide/philosophy.md): the eight ideas behind the rules, decision order and anti-patterns; use it for cases the rules do not cover.
- [Design principles](docs/guide/design-principles.md): shape, motion, color, type and priorities.
- [Navigation](docs/guide/navigation.md): source versus push, shared toolbar and back.

- [Large title](docs/components/navbar.md): title/search/refresh/insets.
- [Sheet](docs/components/sheet.md), [Tab bar](docs/components/tabbar.md), [List](docs/components/list.md).

- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): for modifying the library, not a substitute for app integration.

These are repository-relative links, intended to be read on GitHub or in a checkout.
No instruction file guarantees compliance by an external model; copy the guide and
checklist links into the consuming app's own development instructions.
